name: Study of the Elements: Rock
summary: Lotwil Veriatus is ready to test larger pieces after the small shards behaved as he expected. He needs three large stone slabs from rock elementals.

sections.title: Bigger Pieces
sections.body:
Lotwil Veriatus needs sturdier pieces for his next tests. Rock elementals have larger bodies, so their remains may yield slabs big enough.

He points you farther west or southeast along the mountain edges to gather three large stone slabs. For now, Lotwil needs time to test the smaller pieces you brought.

sections.title: Lotwil's Hopes
sections.body: Lotwil's spells acted on the smaller pieces as he predicted. If the next experiment goes as he expects, the elementals he controls will outshine anything he has summoned before.

faq.q: Who sends you after the large slabs?
faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus, working in the Badlands, sends you to gather the large slabs.
Before this request, you brought Lotwil small stone shards during the earlier Study of the Elements: Rock.

faq.q: Where does Lotwil say to find the rock elementals?
faq.answer: Lotwil points you farther west or southeast along the edges of the mountains.

faq.q: Why does Lotwil need larger stone slabs?
faq.answer: Lotwil needs larger pieces for his next tests. Rock elementals have bigger, stronger bodies, so their remains may yield pieces large enough.
